parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS source_kind,
    NULLIF($2::text, '') AS execution_id,
    left($3::text, 80) AS error_code,
    left($4::text, 500) AS error_message
),
dispatch_owned AS (
  SELECT job.id, job.status
  FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs AS job
  CROSS JOIN input
  WHERE input.source_kind = 'dispatch'
    AND input.execution_id IS NOT NULL
    AND job.dispatch_execution_id = input.execution_id
),
dispatch_cardinality AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) AS owner_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('created', 'staging', 'ready')) AS eligible_count,
    (array_agg(id ORDER BY id) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('created', 'staging', 'ready')))[1] AS eligible_id
  FROM dispatch_owned
),
dispatch_update AS (
  UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs AS job
  SET status = 'failed',
      dispatch_execution_id = NULL,
      error_code = input.error_code,
      error_message = input.error_message,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM input
  CROSS JOIN dispatch_cardinality
  WHERE dispatch_cardinality.owner_count = 1
    AND dispatch_cardinality.eligible_count = 1
    AND job.id = dispatch_cardinality.eligible_id
    AND job.dispatch_execution_id = input.execution_id
    AND job.status IN ('created', 'staging', 'ready')
  RETURNING job.id
),
monitor_owned AS (
  SELECT job.id, job.status
  FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs AS job
  CROSS JOIN input
  WHERE input.source_kind = 'monitor'
    AND input.execution_id IS NOT NULL
    AND job.poll_owner_execution_id = input.execution_id
),
monitor_cardinality AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS owner_count
  FROM monitor_owned
),
monitor_target AS (
  SELECT owned.id
  FROM monitor_owned AS owned
  WHERE owned.status IN ('ready', 'running', 'validating')
),
monitor_update AS (
  UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs AS job
  SET poll_owner_execution_id = NULL,
      poll_claimed_at = NULL,
      validation_summary = jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(
          CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(job.validation_summary) = 'object' THEN job.validation_summary
            ELSE '{}'::jsonb
          END,
          '{monitor_error}',
          jsonb_build_object(
            'code', input.error_code,
            'message', input.error_message,
            'recorded_at', now()
          ),
          true
        ),
        '{monitor_error_count}',
        to_jsonb(LEAST(
          CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(job.validation_summary) = 'object'
              AND job.validation_summary ->> 'monitor_error_count' ~ '^[0-9]{1,7}$'
              THEN (job.validation_summary ->> 'monitor_error_count')::integer
            ELSE 0
          END + 1,
          1000000
        )),
        true
      ),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM input
  CROSS JOIN monitor_cardinality
  WHERE monitor_cardinality.owner_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2
    AND job.id IN (SELECT target.id FROM monitor_target AS target)
    AND job.poll_owner_execution_id = input.execution_id
    AND job.status IN ('ready', 'running', 'validating')
  RETURNING job.id
),
mutation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM dispatch_update) + (SELECT count(*) FROM monitor_update) AS update_count,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(changed.id ORDER BY changed.id)
      FROM (
        SELECT id FROM dispatch_update
        UNION ALL
        SELECT id FROM monitor_update
      ) AS changed
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS job_ids
),
result AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN input.execution_id IS NULL OR input.source_kind = 'invalid_identity' THEN 'invalid_identity'
      WHEN input.source_kind NOT IN ('dispatch', 'monitor') THEN 'unsupported_workflow'
      WHEN input.source_kind = 'dispatch' AND dispatch_cardinality.owner_count > 1 THEN 'ownership_ambiguous'
      WHEN input.source_kind = 'monitor' AND monitor_cardinality.owner_count > 2 THEN 'ownership_ambiguous'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_update) THEN 'dispatch_failed'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monitor_update) THEN 'monitor_lease_released'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs AS job
        WHERE (
          (input.source_kind = 'dispatch' AND job.dispatch_execution_id = input.execution_id)
          OR (input.source_kind = 'monitor' AND job.poll_owner_execution_id = input.execution_id)
        )
          AND job.status IN ('completed', 'canceled', 'failed')
      ) THEN 'terminal_no_op'
      ELSE 'ownership_lost'
    END AS outcome,
    mutation_stats.update_count,
    mutation_stats.job_ids,
    input.source_kind,
    input.execution_id
  FROM input
  CROSS JOIN dispatch_cardinality
  CROSS JOIN monitor_cardinality
  CROSS JOIN mutation_stats
)
SELECT outcome, update_count, job_ids, source_kind, execution_id
FROM result;
